description: Deactivate fragment auto-computation. The previously calculated fragments are not removed - fragment IDs remain assigned to bodies, allowing one to use fragment activate to reactivate automatic fragment calculation later. This only stops the automatic periodic updates; existing fragment data is preserved.
notes: Stops automatic fragment computation (if it was active)
Fragment IDs remain assigned to bodies - data is preserved
Can reactivate with fragment activate to resume auto-computation
Does NOT clear fragment data - use fragment clear for that
Reduces computational overhead when fragment tracking is not needed
If fragments were never activated, this command has no effect
Related commands: fragment activate, fragment clear, fragment compute, fragment list, fragment register
Stops auto-computation only; fragment IDs and history survive, and fragment compute still works manually.
No direct Python SDK method for fragment deactivation
Must use command interface: itasca.command('fragment deactivate')
After deactivation, fragment IDs still accessible: ball.fragment()
Fragment deactivation is a global simulation setting, not object-specific

command_vs_python.python:
itasca.command('fragment deactivate')
# Fragment IDs still available: ball.fragment()

examples.description: Stop automatic fragment computation, preserve existing fragment IDs. Use case: Finished fragment tracking phase, want to reduce overhead.

examples.command:
fragment activate cycles 100
model cycle 5000
fragment deactivate
model cycle 5000
examples.description: Track fragments for first 5000 cycles, then stop tracking for next 5000. Use case: Fragment tracking only needed during specific simulation phase.
Stop auto-computation, then examine current fragment state. Use case: Freeze fragment state for analysis.

examples.command:

model cycle 10000
fragment deactivate
contact delete range model null
fragment compute
fragment activate cycles 50
examples.description: Stop, make manual changes, recompute, restart auto-computation. Use case: Modify contacts mid-simulation with controlled fragment updates.
Stop auto-computation, then clear all fragment data. Use case: Complete cleanup of fragment tracking system.
